portal_hypertension.title: Three-dimensional automated muscle and adipose analysis to predict hepatic encephalopathy after transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhao Y, Huang M, Huang J

portal_hypertension.abstract: Overt hepatic encephalopathy (HE) limits the use of transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) in portal hypertension. We aimed to determine whether automated three-dimensional (3D) body composition analysis could improve pre-TIPS prediction of overt HE compared with conventional two-dimensional (2D) manual assessment. This multicenter study included 593 eligible patients from seven institutions (training cohort: n = 308; external validation 1 cohort: n = 151; and external validation 2 cohort: n = 134).
